capabilities: Remove the background of embedded cards in canvas files
Configure which embed types get transparent backgrounds
extras: Screenshots are referenced in the README but not included in the text version.
intentEvidence: This obsidian.md plugin allows you to make the background of cards transparent in the Canvas
problem: Embedded cards in Obsidian Canvas (images, canvases, markdown) have opaque backgrounds that cover content behind them.
summary: Canvas plugin that makes the backgrounds of embedded cards transparent in canvas files.
